evidence.section: 3.2. Effect of C on rupture properties
evidence.quote: high-carbon alloy has many pores inside, resulting in the lowest rupture life of 178.9 h.

The rupture tests conducted at 760 ◦C/780 MPa revealed that the grain boundary strengthening effect is significant when an appropriate amount of carbon (0.10 wt%) is added to the alloy, resulting in the strengthening effect of MC and M23C6.

evidence.section: 3.2. Effect of C on rupture properties
evidence.quote: The initial MC carbides are less in low-carbon, which has a weak dispersion strengthening, resulting in the rupture life being slightly lower than that of medium-carbon.

evidence.section: 3.2. Effect of C on rupture properties
evidence.quote: the discrete M 23C6 particles formed in the γ channel under the medium-carbon can prevent dislocation movement through dislocation entanglement and locking, which is beneficial to improving the rupture properties.
